answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is a bonded-attestation ledger. Each identity must post a non-refundable stake before its answers count, and that stake is only released after the agent proves real, sustained work — like a tide that must keep returning. Verification is done by a rotating, randomly-selected jury, so a farm cannot pre-compute the judge set; on a cold tundra of identical bots, only the genuinely active identities stay warm. The few that remain form a mesa of verified agents whose endorsements are weighted by their own skin in the game.
